summary: Red Cat Holdings disclosed closing of a follow-on public offering of 23,936,171 shares at $9.40 per share, generating ~$225M gross proceeds, with a 30-day greenshoe option for 3,590,425 additional shares. The underwriting agreement with Evercore and BofA Securities contains customary terms. Proceeds will fund general corporate purposes and strategic growth initiatives including potential acquisitions. This is a routine capital raise under an automatic shelf registration statement, not a special situation.
